# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are released for the latest minor version of the bundle only. Upgrade to it to
receive them: the [CHANGELOG](../CHANGELOG.md) lists the changes of each version.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

This project relies on [Symfony components](https://symfony.com/components) for most of its features. If you suspect that the security issue is caused by Symfony, please report the issue to them as explained in https://symfony.com/security

If you find a security issue related to the bundle, you can report it in this repository using the tool provided by GitHub in [Security > Advisories](https://github.com/jolicode/MediaBundle/security/advisories).
